question: Should OpenClaw runtime Docker and Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain sandbox-only?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible, but the choice affects runtime container UX, Docker/Podman setup contracts, and the sandbox path convention, so automation should not pick the policy by itself.

options.title: Expose a runtime alias
options.body: Add a consistent `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof.

options.title: Keep sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Leave runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Defer behind Docker sandbox mapping
options.body: Resolve the adjacent Docker-outside-of-Docker workspaceAccess path contract first, then apply one workspace path policy to runtime and sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Expose a runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a consistent `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current blame signal across the Dockerfile, Docker setup, Compose, Podman launcher, and Quadlet surfaces.
